integrity: Analytic proof given; independent same-turn stdlib exact coefficient checks and seeded simulations provided. Source date reflects the earliest precisely day-verified public release of the selected primary-MSC literature anchor, not a claim about the original invention of the two classical tests.
scientific_limitations: The finite-sample formulas require iid observations from a known continuous null with no fitted parameters; no joint tail distribution, combined-test calibration, or extension to composite nulls is proved. Previously published equivalent calculations under alternate notation remain an acknowledged originality risk.
title: Exact finite-sample covariance of Watson and Anderson–Darling goodness-of-fit statistics
